question: Which two AWS services support gateway endpoints?
explanation: Gateway endpoints support only Amazon S3 and DynamoDB. They are free and use route table entries to direct traffic. All other services use interface endpoints (PrivateLink).

question: What is the cost difference between gateway and interface endpoints?

options.text: Gateway endpoints are free; interface endpoints are charged
Interface endpoints are free; gateway endpoints are charged
Both have the same hourly charge

explanation: Gateway endpoints (S3/DynamoDB) are free. Interface endpoints (PrivateLink) are charged per hour and per GB of data processed.

question: What controls access through a VPC endpoint?
explanation: Endpoint policies control which AWS resources can be accessed through the VPC endpoint. They work alongside IAM policies and security groups for defense in depth.
